griegas.add_leg_info: Add at least one leg to see portfolio Greeks.
griegas.def_delta: **Δ = ∂V/∂S** — Sensitivity to spot change. Call ∈ [0,1], Put ∈ [-1,0]. ATM ≈ ±0.5.
griegas.def_gamma: **Γ = ∂²V/∂S²** — Price curvature. Max at ATM. Measures Delta change rate.
griegas.def_vega: **ν = ∂V/∂σ** — Sensitivity to implied vol change (+1%). Always positive in vanilla.
griegas.def_rho: **ρ = ∂V/∂r** — Sensitivity to risk-free rate. Call>0, Put<0.
griegas.def_theta: **Θ = ∂V/∂T** — Time decay (per year). Typically negative: time destroys value.
griegas.def_theta_day: **Θ/365** — Daily decay. More intuitive for operational management.
griegas.def_dividend_rho: **∂V/∂q** — Sensitivity to dividend change. Call<0 (more div → less call value).
griegas.def_strike_sens: **∂V/∂K** — Sensitivity to strike change. Call<0, Put>0.
griegas.def_elasticity: **ε = S·Δ/V** — Elasticity: % change in V for 1% change in S. High in OTM (leverage).
